name: Acquisition by Option -- Spouse of a Luxembourgish National

qualifying_event.description: A spouse of a Luxembourgish national may acquire Luxembourgish nationality by a declaration of option, subject to language and civics conditions and (if residing abroad) a minimum marriage duration.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Marriage certificate; Luxembourgish language test certificate; civics course completion.

requirements.blocker_text: Must be married to a Luxembourgish national. Gender-neutral.
Requires a Luxembourgish language test pass certificate.
Must complete the 'Vivre ensemble au Grand-Duche de Luxembourg' civics course, or pass an exam on its content.

If residing outside Luxembourg, requires at least 3 years of marriage, unless the Luxembourgish spouse works for Luxembourg public authorities or an international organisation (in which case the duration requirement is waived per the source).

evidence_required.document: Civics course completion certificate or exam pass

sources.title: Guichet.lu -- Acquiring Luxembourgish Nationality by Option: case 3, spouses of Luxembourgish nationals -- language test, civics course, 3-year marriage duration if residing abroad

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Luxembourg). Gender-neutral. Unlike the reduced-residence-bar marriage routes modeled for Bulgaria and Finland elsewhere in this dataset, Luxembourg's spouse route has NO stated residence-duration requirement for a spouse actually living in Luxembourg -- only the language test and civics course (same as standard naturalisation) -- while a spouse residing ABROAD instead faces a 3-year marriage-duration requirement in place of a residence requirement. This is a declaration ('option'), not a grand-ducal naturalisation decree, though the practical language/civics bar is the same either way.
